title: Enhanced Proton Torpedoes
caption: Enhanced Proton Torpedoes (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your starfighter. May target a starship for free. Draw destiny (if on a Heroic starfighter, may first use 1 Force to add 3 to total). Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Often modified by Rebellion technicians. Heavy warhead provides increased armor penetration. Decreased maneuverability and effectiveness against starfighters.
